battle.name: 立陶宛獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 立陶宛獨立戰爭是維基戰爭列表所列的獨立衝突，1918年立陶宛宣布獨立後，波蘭與白俄等勢力先後介入，戰事延續至國家地位確立。1840年已列裝法軍的雷管步槍（Percussion rifle）屬制式步兵武器，符合此時地面作戰的裝備年代。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管步槍（Percussion rifle）在1840年列裝法軍後，屬陸軍步兵制式槍械，主要供步兵執行中遠距離射擊，構成法軍地面部隊的基礎步兵火力。

countries: 1918年2月16日以後，波羅的海東岸的立陶宛成為交戰區，參與者的身分也隨月份改變。立陶宛方面先由立陶宛委員會、國務委員會及各地武裝構成的軍隊作戰；1918年4月建立總參謀部，1919年11月2日才以立陶宛軍的名義正式建軍，但這是制度上的里程碑，不表示此前沒有作戰軍隊。蘇維埃俄羅斯的紅軍從東南方進入，企圖把俄羅斯帝國解體後形成的邊界固定在莫斯科控制之下。帝國德國先占領維爾紐斯，再以武器、軍官、經費及訓練扶植立陶宛，使其成為德俄邊界上的緩衝。波蘭方面起初並非以國家軍隊參戰：齊格蒙特·熱利戈夫斯基率領的波蘭第一軍團原被編入紅軍序列，1918年8月抗命後占領維爾紐斯，並建立中部立陶宛自治政權；1920年波蘭共和國軍隊才直接投入攻勢。因此，明確的前線包括立陶宛對紅軍，以及立陶宛對熱利戈夫斯基部隊和後來波蘭正規軍；德軍則先後以占領者、援助者及撤軍當事方的身分介入，不能把整場戰爭簡化成單一國界之爭。
countriesEn: After 16 February 1918, Lithuania on the eastern Baltic coast became a theatre of war, while the identities of the participants changed from month to month. On the Lithuanian side, fighting was initially conducted by the Council of Lithuania, the State Council and locally formed armed groups. A General Staff was established in April 1918, and the Lithuanian Army was formally constituted under that name on 2 November 1919; that date marked an institutional milestone rather than the first existence of an armed force. The Red Army of Soviet Russia entered from the east and southeast in an effort to fix the borders created by the collapse of the Russian Empire under Moscow's control. The German Empire occupied Vilnius first, then supported Lithuania with weapons, officers, funds and training so that it could serve as a buffer between Germany and Russia. The Polish side did not initially participate as the national army of an independent state. The Polish I Corps led by Zygmunt Żeligowski, originally incorporated into the Red Army, broke with it in August 1918, occupied Vilnius and established a Central Lithuanian autonomous administration. Direct intervention by the armed forces of the Second Polish Republic came only in 1920. The clearly identifiable fronts were therefore Lithuania against the Red Army and Lithuania against Żeligowski's troops and the later Polish regular army. Germany intervened successively as occupier, sponsor and withdrawing party, so the conflict cannot be reduced to a single dispute over one border.
people: 1918年2月16日，二十位立陶宛委員會代表在獨立宣言上簽署，約拿斯·巴薩納維丘斯、安塔納斯·斯梅托納和佩特拉斯·克利馬斯是其中的核心人物。斯梅托納主持國務委員會並處理政府的政治方向；巴薩納維丘斯參與主席團工作；克利馬斯則在1918年3月率領代表團前往德國，取得德國對立陶宛國家地位的承認。軍事方面，軍人康斯坦丁斯·朱卡斯首先整理立陶宛部隊與指揮關係，4月下旬出任最初的武裝力量指揮官；普拉納斯·利亞圖卡斯自5月1日至10月18日擔任總司令，並在秋季因國務委員會同軍方權責分歧而辭職；安塔納斯·梅爾基斯在1918年4月至10月主持總參謀部，負責把各地志願隊、徵集人員與分散武器編成可持續作戰的單位。朱卡斯其後再次接掌最高指揮權。德國軍事顧問團由赫爾曼·馮·加拉廷伯爵率領，協調德制武器、訓練和德軍聯絡，但指揮鏈並未完全並入立陶宛總參謀部。齊格蒙特·熱利戈夫斯基則是波方最關鍵的人物，他先率波蘭第一軍團脫離紅軍，繼而在維爾紐斯建立自己的指揮與行政體系。真正落實這些決定的，是各師旅的軍官、營連長、通信兵、炮兵觀察員和連級軍士，他們負責把政治目標轉成地圖上的防線、彈藥分配與行軍時刻。
peopleEn: On 16 February 1918, twenty representatives of the Council of Lithuania signed the Act of Independence, with Jonas Basanavičius, Antanas Smetona and Petras Klimas among its central figures. Smetona chaired the State Council and directed its political work; Basanavičius participated in its presidium; and Klimas led a delegation to Germany in March 1918 that secured Berlin's recognition of Lithuania as a state. On the military side, Konstantinas Žukas first organized the relationship between Lithuanian forces and their command structure and became the initial commander of the armed force in late April. Pranas Liatukas served as commander-in-chief from 1 May to 18 October and resigned that autumn amid disagreements between the State Council and the military over authority. Antanas Merkys headed the General Staff from April to October 1918 and was responsible for turning local volunteer detachments, conscripted personnel and scattered weapons into units capable of sustained operations. Žukas later returned as the senior commander. The German military mission was headed by Count Hermann von Galatin, who coordinated German weapons, training and contact with German troops, although his mission did not simply become part of the Lithuanian General Staff. Zygmunt Żeligowski was the decisive Polish figure: he first led the Polish I Corps out of the Red Army and then created his own command and administrative structure in Vilnius. Division commanders, battalion and company officers, signallers, artillery observers and company NCOs converted political decisions into front lines, ammunition allocations and march schedules on the ground.
kits: 1918年的立陶宛軍械並不是單一制式，而是俄德兩套庫存與前線繳獲物拼成的過渡體系。步兵的主要步槍包括俄制莫辛－那丹特M1891，口徑7.62毫米，使用7.62×54毫米R步槍彈；帝國德國的Gewehr 88 M1878/79及7.92×57毫米步槍彈則隨受援部隊和德軍存在。輕機槍可見俄制 Maxim 水冷式M1895／M1910，採Sokolov支架，亦有德制MG 08/15； Maxim使用7.62×54毫米R，MG 08/15則使用7.92×57毫米。炮兵方面，早期俄制76毫米師屬炮M1902、德制77毫米FK 96、150毫米leFH 13及105毫米leFH 16均已在1918年前列入軍械序列，leFH 16更是在1916年即已服役；不同口徑炮彈、瞄準具和炮架不能直接互換。制式手槍有俄制Nagant M1897與德制Luger P08。裝具包括德國M1916鋼盔、灰色野戰服、皮革彈藥盒、綁腿、野外電話、馬匹、馬車，以及從俄軍和德軍倉庫接收的通訊器材。槍械型號與野戰服混用，使維修、備件和瞄準基準十分繁雜；步槍彈供應尚能維持時，炮彈裝載量、鐵路運輸和前沿彈藥前置不足往往更早造成火力中斷。德軍撤離後，立陶宛從殘留倉庫和繳獲物補足部分火炮與彈藥，卻失去穩定的後續補充，因此前線單位常以運輸距離決定射擊強度和預備隊位置。
kitsEn: The Lithuanian armament in 1918 was a transitional system assembled from Russian and German inventories and material captured at the front rather than from a single standard. The principal infantry rifle was the Russian Mosin-Nagant Model 1891 in 7.62 mm, firing 7.62×54mmR ammunition. The Imperial German Gewehr 88 Model 1878/79 and its 7.92×57mm ammunition were present through German units and military support. Light machine guns included the Russian Maxim water-cooled Model 1895 or Model 1910 on the Sokolov mount and the German MG 08/15. The Maxim used 7.62×54mmR while the MG 08/15 used 7.92×57mm. In the artillery arm, the early stocks included the Russian 76 mm divisional gun Model 1902, the German 77 mm FK 96, the 150 mm leFH 13 and the 105 mm leFH 16. The last had entered service in 1916. Shell dimensions, sights and carriage fittings could not simply be exchanged between these systems. Standard sidearms included the Russian Nagant Model 1897 and German Luger P08. Equipment also comprised German M1916 steel helmets, field-grey uniforms, leather ammunition pouches, puttees, field telephones, horses, horse-drawn wagons and communications material taken from Russian and German depots. Mixing rifles and uniforms complicated maintenance, spare parts and sight calibration. Even when rifle ammunition was available, limited shell loading capacity, rail transport and the forward storage of artillery ammunition more often interrupted firepower. After the German withdrawal, Lithuania supplemented some guns and ammunition from residual depots and captured material but lost a dependable supply chain, so transport distance often determined both the rate of fire and the position of reserves.
tactics: 最早能確定位的戰鬥發生於1918年2月19日，立陶宛志願隊在Gataučiai附近擊退紅軍攻擊；2月21日Visabalis一帶再遭紅軍進攻，立陶宛方面在德軍支援下守住陣地。這一階段的立陶宛部隊規模小，依靠村落、樹林、道路交叉點和地方情報作戰，通常先以哨兵與游騎監視，再用步兵、機槍及有限炮火封鎖道路；通訊仍高度依賴騎兵、傳令兵與電話。3月23日德軍進入維爾紐斯後，鐵路倉庫、兵站和較完整的武器來源向立陶宛一側打開，立陶宛總參謀部得以建立固定營區、訓練場與供應路線。夏秋兩季，德軍和立陶宛部隊沿Tauragė、Biržai、Rūdiškės等道路與鐵路軸線肅清紅軍據點，立陶宛軍一面鞏固村鎮和渡口，一面保護由Kaunas通往Vilnius、Šiauliai的補給線。波蘭第一軍團的轉變則顯示另一種速度：該軍團於8月在明斯克公開抗命，8月14日占領維爾紐斯，9月29日進取Medininkai；波軍利用既有鐵路、炮兵和較集中的縱隊迅速推進，立陶宛方面則以Medininkai、Širvintos與Gerviškis等節點維持防線，未在準備不足時強攻完整的維爾紐斯城防。11月德國停戰及撤軍使德方軍械倉庫和城市控制問題同時惡化，12月10日立陶宛與蘇維埃俄羅斯達成停戰，紅軍卻仍向立陶宛境內推進。1919年1月7日紅軍發動攻勢，1月8日至9日的Pandėlys戰鬥中，立陶宛軍利用道路、村落和機槍射界阻止其在冰封地形上展開，炮兵則集中支援受威脅地段。1919年4月23日德軍把維爾紐斯交給立陶宛軍；同年夏季熱利戈夫斯基部隊重新越過Latvian方向進入立陶宛，7月25日占領維爾紐斯，並在Radviliškis一帶與追擊部隊交戰。1920年波蘭正規軍投入後，戰線向東北部移動，7月14日波軍控制Žmudžiai，10月9日占領維爾紐斯；立陶宛軍在彈藥、鐵路調度和縱深均受限制的情況下退向西部與西南部防線，獨立在軍事上仍得以延續。
tacticsEn: The earliest combat that can be placed precisely occurred on 19 February 1918, when Lithuanian volunteers repelled a Red Army attack near Gataučiai. Another attack followed near Visabalis on 21 February, and the Lithuanian position was held with German support. At this stage the Lithuanian units were small and fought around villages, woodland, road junctions and local intelligence. Outposts and mounted patrols screened the approaches, while infantry, machine guns and limited artillery blocked the roads. Communication still relied heavily on mounted messengers, order-bearing personnel and telephones. After German troops entered Vilnius on 23 March, railway warehouses, staging points and more complete stocks of weapons became available to the Lithuanian side, allowing the General Staff to establish permanent barracks, training grounds and supply routes. During the summer and autumn, German and Lithuanian forces cleared Red Army positions along road and rail axes such as Tauragė, Biržai and Rūdiškės. Lithuanian units consolidated villages and river crossings while protecting the supply lines from Kaunas toward Vilnius and Šiauliai. The change in the Polish I Corps demonstrated a different tempo. It openly broke with the Red Army in Minsk in August, occupied Vilnius on 14 August and advanced upon Medininkai on 29 September. The Polish troops moved rapidly using existing railways, artillery and more concentrated columns, while the Lithuanian command maintained a line through Medininkai, Širvintos and Gerviškis and avoided an immediate assault on the fully prepared defences of Vilnius without adequate preparation. The German armistice and withdrawal in November worsened problems involving German depots and control of the cities. The armistice between Lithuania and Soviet Russia was signed on 10 December, yet Red Army forces continued to advance inside Lithuania. On 7 January 1919 the Red Army launched an offensive. During the Battle of Pandėlys on 8 and 9 January, Lithuanian troops used roads, villages and machine-gun fields of fire to prevent deployment across the frozen ground, with artillery concentrated on the most threatened sectors. German troops handed Vilnius to the Lithuanian Army on 23 April 1919. In the following summer, Żeligowski's forces re-entered Lithuania from the Latvian direction, captured Vilnius on 25 July and fought pursuing troops around Radviliškis. After regular Polish forces entered the conflict in 1920, the front shifted toward the northeast. Polish troops took control of Žmudžiai on 14 July and captured Vilnius on 9 October. With ammunition, rail scheduling and depth all constrained, Lithuanian forces withdrew toward defensive lines in the west and southwest, and Lithuanian independence nevertheless survived militarily.
data: 可核對的時間與制度資料先從1918年2月16日開始，當日共有二十位代表簽署獨立宣言；3月3日德俄《布列斯特－立陶宛條約》簽訂，3月21日德國承認立陶宛，4月15日美國總統威爾遜宣布承認立陶宛。立陶宛總參謀部在1918年4月成立，早期紀錄常列第1及第2薩莫吉提亞步兵團等常規單位；到1918年11月，常見的戰後編制統計為四個師、十五個步兵團、三個騎兵團及十二個炮兵連。1919年11月2日是立陶宛軍正式成立的日期，因此它不應取代1918年已存在的實際作戰記錄。交通方面，立陶宛沿用俄國帝國的1,524毫米標準軌，Vilnius－Kaunas－Šiauliai、Vilnius－Lida、Šiauliai通往拉脫維亞方向及Kaunas通往德國方向的路線，決定了兵員、糧食、炮彈和傷員後送的速度。Vilnius與Kaunas曾是主要兵站和庫存中心，但德軍撤離造成彈藥分布不均，前線必須以分車、小批量和馬車接續，許多連隊因此在攻擊前便耗盡攜行彈藥。總參謀部使用野戰電話和軍用電報連接師旅與交通線，前線通訊仍會因道路破壞、鐵路調度中斷或指揮部遭撤離而中斷。1918年12月10日的蘇維埃俄羅斯－立陶宛停戰、1920年7月12日的《莫斯科和約》與1922年2月5日的Suwałki協議，分別標記不同戰線的收束。現有資料中的首批戰鬥、1919年冬季戰役及城市攻堅傷亡數字互相衝突且殘缺，因此不能把不同版本的估算包裝成精確傷亡。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology begins on 16 February 1918, when twenty representatives signed the Act of Independence. The Treaty of Brest-Litovsk between Germany and Soviet Russia was signed on 3 March; Germany recognized Lithuania on 21 March; and President Wilson announced United States recognition on 15 April. The Lithuanian General Staff was established in April 1918, and early records commonly list regular formations such as the 1st and 2nd Žemaičių, or Samogitian, infantry regiments. By November 1918, frequently cited postwar establishment statistics list four divisions, fifteen infantry regiments, three cavalry regiments and twelve artillery batteries. The formal establishment of the Lithuanian Army on 2 November 1919 did not replace the operational record of 1918. Transport was equally important. Lithuania inherited the Russian imperial standard gauge of 1,524 mm. The routes from Vilnius through Kaunas to Šiauliai, from Vilnius toward Lida, from Šiauliai toward Latvia and from Kaunas toward Germany determined the speed with which troops, food, shells and wounded could move. Vilnius and Kaunas served as major staging points and depots, but the German withdrawal left ammunition unevenly distributed. The forward line often had to continue deliveries in small rail consignments and by horse-drawn wagon, and many companies exhausted their carried ammunition before an attack. The General Staff connected divisions and transport points with field telephones and military telegraph, although front communications still failed when roads were damaged, railway scheduling was interrupted or headquarters moved. The Soviet Russian–Lithuanian armistice of 10 December 1918, the Treaty of Moscow of 12 July 1920 and the Suwałki Agreement of 5 February 1922 marked the closure of different fronts. Existing casualty figures for the opening battles, the winter fighting of 1919 and the urban assaults are contradictory and incomplete, so competing estimates cannot responsibly be presented as precise casualty totals.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接政治背景，是俄羅斯帝國在一戰末期因軍政崩解而失去對邊疆的實際控制。1918年2月16日的宣言不是一份臨時戰鬥命令，而是以立陶宛委員會的名義宣布恢復國家，並提出由本國權力管理維爾紐斯、Klaipėda及其餘傳統領土的完整政治主張。此後《布列斯特－立陶宛條約》改變了外部條件：俄羅斯放棄對這些地區的權利主張，德國則取得極大的戰略與經濟利益，並於3月21日承認立陶宛。德國支持立陶宛，既是為了建立緩衝、維持東線安全，也是為了塑造一個受柏林影響的鄰國，因此援助附帶政治條件，並不保證所有邊界都會交給立陶宛。蘇維埃俄羅斯紅軍介入，則是要阻止分離主義政權在舊俄羅斯境內固定，並將立陶宛及其他西部地區納入革命政府的軍事秩序。波蘭問題又增加了第三重衝突：波蘭方面要求維爾紐斯及前立陶宛大公國部分土地，熱利戈夫斯基的軍團雖曾與紅軍共同作戰，卻不代表波蘭共和國政府授權他建立獨立的中部立陶宛政權。軍事物資同樣是起義能否延續的原因：立陶宛有政治組織、地方武裝與前帝國軍人，卻缺乏完整重武器、統一彈藥和受控制的鐵路；德國提供裝備與訓練後，立陶宛才能把零散抵抗編成軍隊。因而戰爭不是單一民族情緒造成，而是國家重建、德俄緩衝、蘇維埃集權、波蘭邊界要求與軍備差距同時作用的結果。
causeEn: The immediate political background was the military and administrative disintegration of the Russian Empire late in the First World War and its effective loss of control over the borderlands. The declaration of 16 February 1918 was not merely an order for battle. It spoke in the name of the Council of Lithuania, announced the restoration of the state and asserted a complete political claim to administer Vilnius, Klaipėda and the remaining traditional territories under Lithuanian authority. The Treaty of Brest-Litovsk then changed the external conditions. Russia renounced its claims to these territories, while Germany acquired substantial strategic and economic interests and recognized Lithuania on 21 March. German support aimed to create a buffer, secure the eastern front and establish a neighbouring state responsive to Berlin. It therefore carried political conditions and did not guarantee that every claimed border would be transferred to Lithuania. Soviet intervention by the Red Army sought to prevent separatist regimes from consolidating within former Russian territory and to bring Lithuania and the western regions into the military order of the revolutionary government. The Polish question added a third conflict. Polish political authorities demanded Vilnius and parts of the former Grand Duchy of Lithuania, and Żeligowski's corps had fought beside the Red Army without thereby receiving authorization from the Polish Republic to create an independent Central Lithuanian administration. Equipment was equally decisive in allowing the new state to survive. Lithuania had political organization, local armed groups and former imperial soldiers, but lacked heavy weapons, standardized ammunition and controlled railways. German equipment and training made it possible to convert scattered resistance into an army. The war therefore resulted from the interaction of state restoration, the German-Russian buffer policy, Soviet centralization, Polish territorial claims and the material imbalance facing Lithuanian forces, rather than from any single slogan or grievance.
impact: 最直接的制度成果是立陶宛取得一套能延續到後來的軍事行政系統。1918年的總參謀部把地方武裝轉為固定編制，統一番號、指揮關係、軍需表冊與通信程序；1919年實施普遍徵兵後，後備役、徵集區、軍械倉庫、軍醫與訓練單位逐步成形。早期裝備混用俄制與德制型號，也留下維修和後勤上的負擔，但使各級指揮官必須在材料不足下維持輪替、訓練與供應。政治層面上，德國和美國先後承認立陶宛，使1918年2月的宣言取得可見的國際地位；與此同時，德國支持在撤軍後迅速消失，立陶宛不得不靠自身軍隊維持國家運作，並尋求新的外交與裝備來源。東歐局勢也受牽動：波蘭第一軍團在維爾紐斯建立勢力，使波蘭、立陶宛與蘇維埃俄羅斯的邊界問題互相重疊，最終與波蘇戰爭的東線相連。軍事上，立陶宛軍在紅軍的集中步兵、炮兵與鐵路調度面前保存了固定防線，又在1919年冬季戰役中證明由地方情報、機動預備隊和受控火力構成的防衛可以抵擋較大兵力。領土代價則十分清楚：維爾紐斯及東南部在1920年被波蘭控制，分離出立陶宛的直接行政；Klaipėda問題也沒有隨獨立宣告解決，而是延續到國際聯盟另行處理。這場戰爭最終留下兩種同時存在的成果：立陶宛國家與軍隊得以延續，但維爾紐斯、Žmudžiai和Klaipėda的歸屬成為不同時期持續處理的政治與軍事問題。
impactEn: The most direct institutional result was a military-administrative system in Lithuania that continued after the war. In 1918 the General Staff converted local armed groups into permanent formations with standardized designations, command relationships, supply tables and communications procedures. After general conscription was introduced in 1919, reserves, recruitment districts, depots, military medical services and training units gradually took shape. The early mixture of Russian and German weapon models also imposed a maintenance and logistical burden, but it forced commanders to sustain rotations, training and supply despite material shortages. Politically, recognition by Germany and the United States gave the declaration of February 1918 visible international standing. At the same time, German support disappeared rapidly after the withdrawal, forcing Lithuania to maintain the state through its own armed force and seek new diplomatic and material sources. The wider Eastern European situation was also affected. The Polish I Corps established itself at Vilnius, causing Lithuanian, Polish and Soviet boundary questions to overlap and ultimately merge with the eastern front of the Polish–Soviet War. Militarily, the Lithuanian Army preserved fixed defensive lines against Red Army infantry concentrations, artillery and railway movement, and the winter campaign of 1919 demonstrated that local intelligence, mobile reserves and controlled fire could hold against a larger force. The territorial cost was equally clear. Vilnius and the southeast came under Polish control in 1920 and were separated from Lithuania's direct administration, while Klaipėda was not settled by the declaration of independence and required later international action. The war consequently left two results at once: the Lithuanian state and army survived, but Vilnius, Žmudžiai and Klaipėda remained distinct territorial questions handled at different times.
result: 立陶宛獨立戰爭並非在單一日期同時結束，而是分成蘇維埃俄羅斯戰線與波蘭戰線陸續收束。對紅軍的正面戰爭從1918年2月延續到1919年冬季，1919年4月23日立陶宛軍進入維爾紐斯，但同年7月又被熱利戈夫斯基部隊奪回；1920年7月12日《莫斯科和約》簽訂，蘇維埃俄羅斯正式承認立陶宛獨立並與其確定東部邊界，因此這一條戰線以條約而非單一會戰告終。波蘭方面的軍事衝突則延續得更久，1920年7月14日波軍控制Žmudžiai，8月至10月的作戰又把立陶宛軍推向西南，10月9日維爾紐斯落入波蘭軍及熱利戈夫斯基部隊之手，波蘭與立陶宛的直接軍事鬥爭因而仍未結束。1922年2月5日的Suwałki協議才把兩國邊界固定下來，維爾紐斯地區沒有回到立陶宛，Klaipėda則在1923年依國際聯盟的安排轉入立陶宛行政。從軍事結果看，立陶宛在德軍占領、蘇維埃俄羅斯進攻和波蘭攻勢同時存在的情況下保住了國家機關與軍隊，迫使蘇聯並最終迫使波蘭以外交方式承認其獨立；從領土結果看，它取得國際承認與法定國土，卻未能以1918年宣言所主張的邊界作為戰後邊界。因而最準確的總結不是一場決定性的單一戰役，而是一項以維爾紐斯歸屬為中心、經停戰、條約和後續邊界協議分階段完成的國家存續過程。
resultEn: The Lithuanian War of Independence did not end on one date. It closed in stages along separate Soviet and Polish fronts. The direct war against the Red Army ran from February 1918 through the winter of 1919. Lithuanian troops entered Vilnius on 23 April 1919, but Żeligowski's forces retook the city that July. The Treaty of Moscow, signed on 12 July 1920, formally recognized Lithuanian independence by Soviet Russia and established the eastern frontier, so that front ended through a treaty rather than a single decisive battle. The conflict with Poland lasted longer. Polish troops took control of Žmudžiai on 14 July 1920, and operations during August and October pushed Lithuanian forces toward the southwest. Vilnius fell to Polish troops and Żeligowski's formations on 9 October, while direct Polish–Lithuanian military hostilities continued. The Suwałki Agreement of 5 February 1922 finally fixed the border between the two states, and Vilnius did not return to Lithuania. Klaipėda was transferred to Lithuanian administration in 1923 under arrangements made by the League of Nations. In military terms, Lithuania preserved its state institutions and army while facing German occupation, Soviet Russian attacks and a Polish offensive at the same time, forcing the Soviet government and eventually Poland to recognize its independence diplomatically. In territorial terms, it obtained international recognition and a legally defined state, but not the boundaries claimed in the declaration of 1918. The most accurate conclusion is therefore not one decisive battle but a state-survival process centred on the disputed status of Vilnius and completed in stages through armistices, treaties and subsequent border agreements.
